_doc: ember.magnetPull: how hard a shard is pulled toward you once it starts flying to you (1400 = original speed; 1925 = Steve's +25% on 2026-10-06). magnetRange: how close you must be for a shard to start flying. pickupDelayMs: how long a shard bounces before it may fly. iron / hydrogen (Steve, 2026-10-25: the materials of mannies, src/data/manny.json): iron ore sits in the rock, hydrogen vents by water and in the open; nodeSprite is the node, sprite the pickup (both untinted: their colors are their own on every world), glow and spark are palette indexes (the node's light, the sparks a hit throws). Hit a node nodeHits times: nodeDropsPerHit pickups each hit, nodeDropsOnBreak on the last; pickups fly to you like Embers and go into the world's store (planet_states.data.supplies). perWorld nodes of each on a world with resourceNodes 30 (Earth; scaled with resourceNodes, so beacon worlds hold three times as many), starters of them just off the town's lots. They regrow like crystals (backend.json nodeRegrowMinutes). salt / quartz / copper (2026-10-27, the Cems' designs, src/data/designs.json): salt blooms crust out where water dried (pond rims, the Cems' flats, the open on dry worlds), quartz grows out of rock, copper boulders crusted green lie by rock or water; all three go into the world's store like iron, each with its own look and its own sound (Sound.ts mineral). They are placed after iron and hydrogen with their own rng (planetGen minerals), so every older node keeps its index.
